scope: Mail body backfill index recovery follow-up
problem: Moving HTML mail to external storage can replace indexed HTML with canonical plain text. Backfill did not queue a refresh, leaving stale keyword content or AI passage offsets until a manual rebuild.
change: Queue body-free mailbox references in the same transaction as each converted message. Current message-level authorization determines the mailbox projections. Resuming a completed conversion creates no duplicate jobs.

regressions: A migrated message queues exactly one body-free refresh on resumable backfill.
Thread membership without message access cannot create a private mailbox search projection.
A storage-read failure retries indexing without acknowledging completion or writing an empty document.

deploymentPreflight: Initial copied build files had restrictive permissions. The offline image import check rejected them before the live configuration changed. Artifact permissions were corrected and the same preflight passed before deployment.
limits: No UI changes; no new browser or accessibility run.
No long-duration load test or full recovery onto a different host.
Development-only deployment and previous production acceptance gaps remain.
Search remains asynchronous with the documented candidate limit.
